question: Simplify: (5x + 11y)² + (5x - 11y)²
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use Algebraic Identity: (a + b)² + (a − b)² = 2(a² + b²)

Here, a = 5x and b = 11y

⇒ Result = 2[(5x)² + (11y)²]

⇒ 2[25x² + 121y²] = 50x² + 242y²

**∴ The correct answer is 50x² + 242y².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given expression: (5x + 11y)² + (5x − 11y)²

Formula used: (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b² and (a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b²

⇒ (5x + 11y)² = (5x)² + 2(5x)(11y) + (11y)²

⇒ (5x + 11y)² = 25x² + 110xy + 121y²

⇒ (5x − 11y)² = (5x)² − 2(5x)(11y) + (11y)²

⇒ (5x − 11y)² = 25x² − 110xy + 121y²

⇒ Adding both results: (25x² + 110xy + 121y²) + (25x² − 110xy + 121y²)

⇒ (25x² + 25x²) + (110xy − 110xy) + (121y² + 121y²)

⇒ 50x² + 0 + 242y²

⇒ 50x² + 242y²

**∴ The correct answer is 50x² + 242y².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Standard Algebraic Identities

(a + b)² − (a − b)² = 4ab

Sum and Difference Identity

(a + b)(a − b) = a² − b²

Perfect Square Trinomial

(a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca
